title: A Fungus Is Still Erasing Amphibian Species
hook: Hundreds of amphibians were hit, and many survivors are still declining.
closing: Stopping chytrid matters because surviving amphibians are still losing ground.
question: Which amphibians should recovery protect?

segments.say: Chytrid fungus affected 501 amphibian species. The disease reached far beyond isolated frog populations.
Thirty-nine percent of affected species are still declining. Surviving the first outbreak did not end the damage.
Chytrid fungus hit 40 Australian frog species. The national toll shows the disease remains widespread.
